def compute_power(base, exponent, modulus):
    result = 1
    while exponent > 0:
        if exponent & 1:
            result = (result * base) % modulus
        base = (base * base) % modulus
        exponent >>= 1
    return result

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    MOD = 1000000007
    if k == 0:
        print(compute_power(p, p - 1, MOD))
        return
    if k == 1:
        print(compute_power(p, p, MOD))

    visited = [False] * (p + 1)
    cycle_length = 1
    current_value = k

    while not visited[current_value]:

        current_value = (current_value * k) % p

    total_power = (p - 1) // cycle_length
    print(compute_power(p, total_power, MOD))
